metrics.name: trackspense_api_requests
metrics.description: Normalized backend API request outcomes (excludes raw platform request logs).

metrics.name: trackspense_api_duration_ms
metrics.description: Body-complete backend API request duration in milliseconds.

metrics.name: trackspense_component_duration_ms
metrics.description: Bounded DB acquisition/execution, OCR, AI and fallback component timings.

metrics.name: trackspense_client_duration_ms
metrics.description: Consent-gated, untrusted client operation and time Web Vital durations (ms only).
metrics.filter: jsonPayload.service="trackspense-backend" AND jsonPayload.event="client_diagnostic" AND jsonPayload.unit="ms" AND jsonPayload.duration_ms>=0

metrics.name: trackspense_client_cls_score
metrics.description: Consent-gated, untrusted web CLS scores (dimensionless score, separate from ms).
metrics.filter: jsonPayload.service="trackspense-backend" AND jsonPayload.event="client_diagnostic" AND jsonPayload.operation="cls" AND jsonPayload.unit="score"

metrics.name: trackspense_client_outcomes
metrics.description: Consent-gated, untrusted client operation outcomes and error categories.
